cohort: 4360 women diagnosed with severe maternal outcome (SMO) in 42 Nigerian tertiary-hospitals between June 2012 and mid-August 2013, and 1000 obstetric admissions without SMO diagnosis
finding: A simple score-based obstetric early-warning-system (EWS) algorithm was developed and validated for predicting severe maternal outcome in resource-limited settings, using readily available clinical observations.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth and the number of previous cesarean births were included in the final prediction model for severe maternal outcome.
